tasks.instruction: Implement metric-aware camera frame assembly using the new experimental H3 adapter, without enabling scenes/portals/renderers. Allowed ONLY engine/geometry/metric-space.js, engine/world/camera-frame.js, hyperbolic-camera.test.js, docs/qa/claude-metric-camera.md. Contract: introduce ambientDot(a,b) on existing E3/S3 metric adapters: finite vectors of the adapter dimension, Euclidean scalar (including off-tangent vectors). spherical-cover inherits via spread. hyperbolic-space.js already exposes validated Lorentz ambientDot. Camera toTangent repairs off-tangent input by coefficients ambientDot(v,basisAxis); createCameraFrame cross-product coefficients use metric dot at position for already repaired tangents. Remove raw ambient Euclidean assumptions, never fallback to Euclidean for an unknown metric. Preserve E3/S3 numeric parity and carried frames, do not rebuild from construction frame after motion. Read H3_CONNECTED_CONTRACT.md and relevant camera code only. Add H3 camera tests at off-origin points: orientation/handedness via independently computed Lorentz products, turns and step carry, drift repair, E3/S3 regressions. Do not modify H3 adapter, connected-global-model, schemas/portals/shaders or admit H3 scenes. Report out-of-scope issues. Focused Node + syntax only, no browser/queue/full suite/commits/push/agents. Include isolated failure demonstration. Report under350 words.

Read adapter and H3_CONNECTED_CONTRACT.md; do not copy lead tests wholesale. Fixed seeded directions including non-axis points near radial3.9 (numerical envelope4), physical R=.5/8/10000 and extent<=2R. Use independent Lorentz identities or alternative analytic geometry for distance/transport, linearity, repeated transported frames, and domain exit (first exit, range truncation, inward/outward near-boundary, tiny positive extents). Author decode domain2R differs numerical representability4R: not a collision wall. Do not compare vectors at different points without transport. Seek counterexamples; report instead of repairing production. Metric factory intentionally refuses h3; import the experimental adapter directly. Tests must not assert unsupported scene/portal/GPU support. Isolated fail-demo, no live source mutations. Focused Node only; no full suite/browser/queue/commits/push/agents. Report under350words with measured residuals and sampled-not-proof limits.
